page.content:
Orbital observatory launched in 1990 and repaired in space by Shuttle crews.

How Hubble Space Telescope connects

  • Faction: Space Shuttle program — Shuttle crews launched Hubble and later repaired it in orbit.
  • Location: Goddard Space Flight Center — Goddard operates Hubble as NASA's science-operations center.
  • Item: James Webb Space Telescope — JWST followed Hubble as NASA's flagship space observatory.

What is Hubble Space Telescope?

Hubble, a NASA–ESA telescope operated with Goddard, transformed public astronomy after Shuttle servicing missions corrected its mirror and kept it working for decades.

Key threads lead to Space Shuttle program, Goddard Space Flight Center and James Webb Space Telescope.
